title: Alois Erdtelt, German Painting Teacher
content: Portrait by Alois Erdtelt (German, 1851-1911)Alois Erdtelt was a painter in Munich, notable for teaching many women artists, includingMaria Slavona,Ida Gerhardi,Ivana Kobilca,Rosa Pfäffinger, andHedwig Weiß. Links take you to Wiki pages about those students.More about Alois Erdtelt atWikipedia.
